Validate Scores

Validate scores using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

validate_scores(scores)

Example input

{
  "scores": {
    "correctness": 4,
    "autonomy": 4,
    "actionability": 4,
    "safety": 4,
    "concision": 4
  }
}

Example output

true

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py validate_scores < examples/validate-scores.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
